ammonia.reason: Low proteolysis deamination by P.candidum/Geotrichum; rises only if overripe, young triple-cream is mild.

animal_barnyard.reason: No washed-rind Brevibacterium activity; pasteurized cow milk with white mold only.

bitter.reason: Few hydrophobic bitter peptides from rennet proteolysis, masked by 40% fat and 2% salt.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti; white P.camemberti makes little 2-heptanone/2-nonanone.

browning.reason: High fat/low reducing sugar young bloomy rind, limited Maillard when heated.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate fermentation by Lc.lactis biovar diacetylactis plus delta-lactones from added cream.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Mild lipolysis releasing butanoic/hexanoic acids; short-aged bloomy, not long lipase-ripened.

creaminess.reason: 75% FDM triple-cream, 48% moisture, deacidified lactic curd gives spoonable high-fat matrix.

crumbliness.reason: High fat-in-dry-matter deacidified lactic curd deforms not fractures.

firmness.reason: Soft bloomy paste with thin rind; dense but yielding, not elastic or hard.

floral_honey.reason: Trace 2-phenylethanol/phenylacetaldehyde from phenylalanine catabolism by Geotrichum.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate esterification of free fatty acids by Geotrichum candidum esterases.

goaty.reason: Cow milk lacks 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic goaty acids characteristic of goat milk.

malty_nutty.reason: Very low 2-/3-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine; no cooked curd pyrazines or aged proteolysis.

melt.reason: High fat 40%, deacidified pH ~5.8 and hydrated casein allow smooth flow on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one from linoleic acid lipoxygenase by Penicillium camemberti rind.

oil_off.reason: Free fat release from 75% FDM cream-enriched matrix when warmed.

smoky.reason: Not smoked; no guaiacol/syringol phenols from wood smoke.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic acid from mesophilic starter lactic fermentation, pH 4.5 at packing, plus trace acetic.

stretch.reason: Lactic/mixed curd, not pasta-filata; no aligned para-casein fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Pasteurization H2S/dimethyl sulfide driven off; no heated whey protein sulfur retention.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose fermented but glycerol, diacetyl and high fat give sweet-creamy perception.

umami.reason: Moderate glutamate from early white-mold proteolysis of casein.
